label: miso 49 tempderate
definition: MISO 49 KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-09, supersedes miso-48-stgas-srmc): the miso-48 keeper's exact recipe (sourced from its own meta.json) re-solved at HEAD with ONLY temp_dependent_derate=True added -- the per-class dry-bulb-temperature capacity derate curve (CC/CT capacity-neutral reshape, COAL/ST_GAS additive hot-hour derate) replacing the flat net-summer treatment, per docs/handoffs/temp-derate-keeper-rerun-playbook-2026-07.md. A real, literature-cited physical mechanism (arXiv:2311.07001; CPUC R.21-10-002), not fit to any residual -- kept on structure (rule 1) independent of its fit effect, and validated via the rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin (near-identical result with all commitment floors off). C3c scarcity tail (energy-only LMP dual, >$200): miso-48's own model was 0/0/0h (2023/24/25) vs DA actual 1/24/38h; miso-49 is 0/6/3h -- a partial, non-closing improvement in 2024 (25% of the gap) and 2025 (8%), no change in 2023 (actual is only 1h there). C3a mean LMP: 2023/2024 both PASS (DA-diagnostic side rows -2.5%/-1.0%), 2025 -10.7% -> -8.7% (still CAVEAT/commercial-band, narrower vs miso-48). C1 fuel-mix 13/16 -> 14/16, but the flipped row (2023 ST_GAS -8.16 -> -7.99 TWh) is a marginal edge-of-band move, not a structural fix. C2 system volume (2025 gas/coal) is unchanged (-14.7%/+16.3%, same pre-existing coal-for-gas substitution miss). C7 diurnal shape and C8 forced-energy share both still PASS -- the capacity reshape does not push any floor/bridge over its budget. Determination: NOT-YET (same as miso-48; same undocumented FAIL surface: fuelmix, sysvol, price_tail), governance PASS (calibration_attestation.json carries the DOF ledger + the new temp_dependent_derate entry, measured-physical, 6 cited scalars). Zero-forcing ablation twin registered as 2026-07-09-miso-49-tempderate-ablation. Next queued: coal sigmoid fix.
